## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Two defects should be fixed: `slugify` drops non-ASCII letters, so titles in non-Latin scripts produce empty slugs, and the description lacks the `## Testing` section that project policy requires.

## Changes
The pull request adds `app/slug.py` with a `slugify` helper that lowercases a title, replaces runs of characters outside `a-z0-9` with one hyphen, and trims hyphens from the ends. It also adds a parametrized test in `tests/test_slug.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Keep non-ASCII letters and digits in slugs — `slugify("日本語")` returns `""` and `slugify("Café")` returns `"caf"`, because `[^a-z0-9]+` treats every non-ASCII letter as a separator. The description says only "non-alphanumeric characters" are replaced. — Titles written entirely in non-Latin scripts all map to the same empty slug, so their page URLs are empty and collide. — Fix: Substitute on `[\W_]+` to keep Unicode letters, or transliterate to ASCII first if slugs must stay ASCII, and extend `test_slugify` with a non-ASCII title.
- PR body — correctness — Add a `## Testing` section to the description — The description is one paragraph with no `## Testing` heading. `AGENTS.md:4` requires: "Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified." — The description does not say how the change was verified, including whether the added test was run.
